Name: Once Upon A Winter's Eve
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Your first year in the valley can be a little lonely at times.  But it's better when spent with friends.
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT MODDROP

An entry for the SDV community discord server's Winter 2019 event!  Set in your first year in the valley, Evelyn makes sure the farmer doesn't spend the holidays alone.

Co-authored by minervamaga and SpringsSong

This mod requires Content Patcher and Mail Framework Mod to work.

Installation:

Install the latest version of SMAPI.
Install Content Patcher and Mail Framework Mod.
Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the 'Once Upon A Winter's Eve' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
You're done; run the game using SMAPI!
